    ((M (Xconfig s t ρ x)).submatrix
        (idxZ (p := p) ∘ elimSnoc e αidx) (idxZ (p := p) ∘ elimSnoc e jidx)).det =
      ∑ S ∈ (elimI m).powerset,
        (∏ i ∈ S, elimIDiag s (configD t ρ x) e i) *
          ((elimGramZZ s t e αidx jidx +
              diagonal (elimLastDiag s (configD t ρ x) αidx jidx)).submatrix
            (Subtype.val : {x // x ∈ Sᶜ} → Fin m.succ)
            (Subtype.val)).det

name: BollobasNikiforov.det_add_diagonal_eq_sum
statement:
lemma det_add_diagonal_eq_sum {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (d : n → ℝ) :
    (A + diagonal d).det =
      ∑ S : Finset n,
        (∏ i ∈ Sᶜ, d i) *
          (A.submatrix (Subtype.val : {x // x ∈ S} → n)
            (Subtype.val : {x // x ∈ S} → n)).det

name: BollobasNikiforov.det_add_diagonal_eq_sum_subset
statement:
lemma det_add_diagonal_eq_sum_subset {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (d : n → ℝ) (I : Finset n)
    (hd : ∀ i, i ∉ I → d i = 0) :
    (A + diagonal d).det =
      ∑ S ∈ I.powerset,
        (∏ i ∈ S, d i) *
          (A.submatrix (Subtype.val : {x // x ∈ Sᶜ} → n)
            (Subtype.val : {x // x ∈ Sᶜ} → n)).det

name: BollobasNikiforov.det_elimGramZY_factor
statement:
lemma det_elimGramZY_factor (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρval xval : ℝ) {m : ℕ}
    (e : Fin m → Fin k) (jidx : Fin k) :
    (elimGramZY s t ρval xval e jidx).det =
      (∏ a, if a = Fin.last m then ρval else s (elimSnoc e jidx a)) *
        (∏ b, s (elimSnoc e jidx b)) *
          (elimKernelMinorZY t xval e jidx).det

name: BollobasNikiforov.det_elimGramZY_submatrix_factor
statement:
lemma det_elimGramZY_submatrix_factor (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρval xval : ℝ)
    {m : ℕ} (e : Fin m → Fin k) (jidx : Fin k) (S : Finset (Fin m.succ)) :
    ((elimGramZY s t ρval xval e jidx).submatrix
        (Subtype.val : {x // x ∈ Sᶜ} → Fin m.succ) Subtype.val).det =
      (∏ i : {x // x ∈ Sᶜ},
          if i.val = Fin.last m then ρval else s (elimSnoc e jidx i.val)) *
        (∏ i : {x // x ∈ Sᶜ}, s (elimSnoc e jidx i.val)) *
          ((elimKernelMinorZY t xval e jidx).submatrix
            (Subtype.val : {x // x ∈ Sᶜ} → Fin m.succ) Subtype.val).det

name: BollobasNikiforov.det_elimGramZZ_factor
statement:
lemma det_elimGramZZ_factor (s t : Fin k → ℝ) {m : ℕ} (e : Fin m → Fin k)
    (αidx jidx : Fin k) :
    (elimGramZZ s t e αidx jidx).det =
      (∏ a, s (elimSnoc e αidx a)) * (∏ b, s (elimSnoc e jidx b)) *
        ((elimKernelZZ t).submatrix (elimSnoc e αidx) (elimSnoc e jidx)).det

name: BollobasNikiforov.det_elimGramZZ_submatrix_factor
statement:
lemma det_elimGramZZ_submatrix_factor (s t : Fin k → ℝ) {m : ℕ}
    (e : Fin m → Fin k) (αidx jidx : Fin k) (S : Finset (Fin m.succ)) :
    ((elimGramZZ s t e αidx jidx).submatrix
        (Subtype.val : {x // x ∈ Sᶜ} → Fin m.succ) Subtype.val).det =
      (∏ i : {x // x ∈ Sᶜ}, s (elimSnoc e αidx i.val)) *
        (∏ i : {x // x ∈ Sᶜ}, s (elimSnoc e jidx i.val)) *
          ((elimKernelZZ t).submatrix
            (elimSnoc e αidx ∘ (Subtype.val : {x // x ∈ Sᶜ} → Fin m.succ))
            (elimSnoc e jidx ∘ (Subtype.val : {x // x ∈ Sᶜ} → Fin m.succ))).det

name: BollobasNikiforov.det_piecewise_one_eq_compl_minor
statement:
lemma det_piecewise_one_eq_compl_minor {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (S : Finset n) :
    (of (Sᶜ.piecewise A.row (1 : Matrix n n ℝ).row)).det =
      (A.submatrix (Subtype.val : {x // x ∈ Sᶜ} → n) Subtype.val).det

name: BollobasNikiforov.det_smul_row_col
statement:
lemma det_smul_row_col {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (u v : n → ℝ) (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    (of fun i j ↦ u i * v j * A i j).det =
      (∏ i, u i) * (∏ j, v j) * A.det

name: BollobasNikiforov.det_submatrix_finset_eq
statement:
lemma det_submatrix_finset_eq {n : Type*} [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) {s t : Finset n} (h : s = t) :
    (A.submatrix (Subtype.val : {x // x ∈ s} → n) Subtype.val).det =
      (A.submatrix (Subtype.val : {x // x ∈ t} → n) Subtype.val).det

name: BollobasNikiforov.det_submatrix_snoc_eq_det_elim
statement:
lemma det_submatrix_snoc_eq_det_elim (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (e : Fin r → ι) (α j : ι) :
    (A.submatrix (Fin.snoc e α) (Fin.snoc e j)).det =
      (A.submatrix (Sum.elim e fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ α)
        (Sum.elim e fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ j)).det

name: BollobasNikiforov.det_submatrix_subtype_eq_orderEmb
statement:
lemma det_submatrix_subtype_eq_orderEmb {n : Type*}
    [LinearOrder n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (S : Finset n) :
    (A.submatrix (Subtype.val : {x // x ∈ S} → n) Subtype.val).det =
      (A.submatrix (S.orderEmbOfFin rfl) (S.orderEmbOfFin rfl)).det

name: BollobasNikiforov.dotProduct_nonsing_inv_comm
statement:
lemma dotProduct_nonsing_inv_comm {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hU : IsUnit A) (x y : n → ℝ) :
    x ⬝ᵥ (A⁻¹ *ᵥ y) = y ⬝ᵥ (A⁻¹ *ᵥ x)

name: BollobasNikiforov.dotProduct_sum_castSucc
statement:
lemma dotProduct_sum_castSucc {m : ℕ} (P x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) :
    P ⬝ᵥ x =
      (fun i : Fin m => P i.castSucc) ⬝ᵥ (fun j => x j.castSucc) +
        P (Fin.last m) * x (Fin.last m)

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimC0_eq_elimGramE
statement:
lemma elimC0_eq_elimGramE (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) :
    elimC0 s t ρ x = elimGramE s t ρ x

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimC0_eq_sum_scaled
statement:
lemma elimC0_eq_sum_scaled (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) :
    elimC0 s t ρ x =
      (M (Xconfig s t ρ x) idxZ0 idxZ0)⁻¹ •
          vecMulVec (fun α => M (Xconfig s t ρ x) α idxZ0)
            (fun α => M (Xconfig s t ρ x) α idxZ0) +
        ∑ j : Fin k,
          (elimPivot s t ρ x j)⁻¹ •
            vecMulVec (elimRes s t ρ x j) (elimRes s t ρ x j)

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimColArg_monotone
statement:
lemma elimColArg_monotone (t : Fin k → ℝ) (hmono : Monotone t)
    {m : ℕ} {e : Fin m → Fin k} (he : Monotone e)
    {jidx : Fin k} (hj : ∀ i, e i ≤ jidx) :
    Monotone (elimColArg t e jidx)

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimColE_embed
statement:
lemma elimColE_embed (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)
    (a : Option (Fin k)) :
    elimColE s t ρ x (elimEEmbed a) = fun b => elimEE s t ρ x a b

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimColZLead_castSucc
statement:
lemma elimColZLead_castSucc (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)
    {m : ℕ} (hm : m + 1 ≤ k) (α : ConfigIdx k p) :
    (fun i : Fin m => elimColZLead s t ρ x hm α i.castSucc) =
      elimColZLead s t ρ x (Nat.le_of_succ_le hm) α

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimColZLead_last
statement:
lemma elimColZLead_last (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)
    {m : ℕ} (hm : m + 1 ≤ k) (α : ConfigIdx k p) :
    elimColZLead s t ρ x hm α (Fin.last m) =
      M (Xconfig s t ρ x) α (idxZ ⟨m, Nat.lt_of_succ_le hm⟩)

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimEEInv_mulVec
statement:
lemma elimEEInv_mulVec (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)
    (v : Option (Fin k) → ℝ) :
    elimEEInv s t ρ x *ᵥ v =
      fun a =>
        match a with
        | none => (M (Xconfig s t ρ x) idxZ0 idxZ0)⁻¹ * v none
        | some i =>
            (((M (Xconfig s t ρ x)).submatrix (idxZ (p := p)) (idxZ (p := p)))⁻¹ *ᵥ
              fun h => v (some h)) i

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimEE_inv_eq
statement:
lemma elimEE_inv_eq (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) :
    (elimEE s t ρ x)⁻¹ = elimEEInv s t ρ x

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimEE_isHermitian
statement:
lemma elimEE_isHermitian (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ) :
    (elimEE s t ρ x).IsHermitian

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimEE_isSymm
statement:
lemma elimEE_isSymm (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ) :
    (elimEE s t ρ x).IsSymm

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimEE_mulVec_none
statement:
lemma elimEE_mulVec_none (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)
    (v : Option (Fin k) → ℝ) :
    (elimEE s t ρ x *ᵥ v) none =
      M (Xconfig s t ρ x) idxZ0 idxZ0 * v none

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimEE_mulVec_some
statement:
lemma elimEE_mulVec_some (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)
    (v : Option (Fin k) → ℝ) (i : Fin k) :
    (elimEE s t ρ x *ᵥ v) (some i) =
      (((M (Xconfig s t ρ x)).submatrix (idxZ (p := p)) (idxZ (p := p))) *ᵥ
        fun h => v (some h)) i

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimEE_mul_inv
statement:
lemma elimEE_mul_inv (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) :
    elimEE s t ρ x * elimEEInv s t ρ x = 1

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimEE_none_none
statement:
lemma elimEE_none_none (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ) :
    elimEE s t ρ x none none = M (Xconfig s t ρ x) idxZ0 idxZ0

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimEE_none_some
statement:
lemma elimEE_none_some (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ) (i : Fin k) :
    elimEE s t ρ x none (some i) = 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimEE_posDef
statement:
lemma elimEE_posDef (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) :
    (elimEE s t ρ x).PosDef

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimEE_quad
statement:
lemma elimEE_quad (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ) (v : Option (Fin k) → ℝ) :
    v ⬝ᵥ (elimEE s t ρ x *ᵥ v) =
      M (Xconfig s t ρ x) idxZ0 idxZ0 * v none * v none +
        (fun i => v (some i)) ⬝ᵥ
          ((M (Xconfig s t ρ x)).submatrix (idxZ (p := p)) (idxZ (p := p)) *ᵥ
            fun i => v (some i))

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimEE_some_none
statement:
lemma elimEE_some_none (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ) (i : Fin k) :
    elimEE s t ρ x (some i) none = 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimEE_some_some
statement:
lemma elimEE_some_some (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ) (i h : Fin k) :
    elimEE s t ρ x (some i) (some h) =
      M (Xconfig s t ρ x) (idxZ i) (idxZ h)

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimEEmbed_ne_elimT
statement:
lemma elimEEmbed_ne_elimT (a : Option (Fin k)) (j : Fin p) :
    elimEEmbed (p := p) a ≠ elimT (k := k) j

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimEEmbed_none
statement: lemma elimEEmbed_none : elimEEmbed (p := p) (none : Option (Fin k)) = idxZ0

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimEEmbed_some
statement: lemma elimEEmbed_some (i : Fin k) : elimEEmbed (p := p) (some i) = idxZ i

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimGramE_embed
statement:
lemma elimGramE_embed (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) (a b : Option (Fin k)) :
    elimGramE s t ρ x (elimEEmbed a) (elimEEmbed b) = elimEE s t ρ x a b

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimGramE_embed_y
statement:
lemma elimGramE_embed_y (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) (a : Option (Fin k)) (ℓ : Fin p) :
    elimGramE s t ρ x (elimEEmbed a) (idxY ℓ) = elimET s t ρ x a ℓ

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimGramE_eq_z0_add_Z
statement:
lemma elimGramE_eq_z0_add_Z (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) (α β : ConfigIdx k p) :
    elimGramE s t ρ x α β =
      (M (Xconfig s t ρ x) α idxZ0) *
          ((M (Xconfig s t ρ x) idxZ0 idxZ0)⁻¹ *
            M (Xconfig s t ρ x) β idxZ0) +
        elimGramZLead s t ρ x le_rfl α β

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimGramE_y_embed
statement:
lemma elimGramE_y_embed (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) (j : Fin p) (b : Option (Fin k)) :
    elimGramE s t ρ x (idxY j) (elimEEmbed b) = elimTE s t ρ x j b

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimGramE_y_y
statement:
lemma elimGramE_y_y (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ) (j ℓ : Fin p) :
    elimGramE s t ρ x (idxY j) (idxY ℓ) =
      (elimTE s t ρ x * (elimEE s t ρ x)⁻¹ * elimET s t ρ x) j ℓ

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimGramZLead_eq_sum
statement:
lemma elimGramZLead_eq_sum (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j) :
    ∀ (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ k),
      elimGramZLead s t ρ x hm =
        ∑ j : Fin m,
          (1 / elimPivot s t ρ x (Fin.castLE hm j)) •
            vecMulVec (elimRes s t ρ x (Fin.castLE hm j))
              (elimRes s t ρ x (Fin.castLE hm j))

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimGramZLead_full
statement:
lemma elimGramZLead_full (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j) :
    elimGramZLead s t ρ x le_rfl =
      ∑ j : Fin k,
        (elimPivot s t ρ x j)⁻¹ •
          vecMulVec (elimRes s t ρ x j) (elimRes s t ρ x j)

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimGramZLead_succ
statement:
lemma elimGramZLead_succ (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    {m : ℕ} (hm : m + 1 ≤ k) :
    elimGramZLead s t ρ x hm =
      elimGramZLead s t ρ x (Nat.le_of_succ_le hm) +
        (1 / elimPivot s t ρ x ⟨m, Nat.lt_of_succ_le hm⟩) •
          vecMulVec (elimRes s t ρ x ⟨m, Nat.lt_of_succ_le hm⟩)
            (elimRes s t ρ x ⟨m, Nat.lt_of_succ_le hm⟩)

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimIDiag_castSucc
statement:
lemma elimIDiag_castSucc (s d : Fin k → ℝ) {m : ℕ} (e : Fin m → Fin k) (i : Fin m) :
    elimIDiag s d e i.castSucc = s (e i) * d (e i)

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimIDiag_eq_zero_of_not_mem
statement:
lemma elimIDiag_eq_zero_of_not_mem (s d : Fin k → ℝ) {m : ℕ} (e : Fin m → Fin k)
    {a : Fin m.succ} (ha : a ∉ elimI m) : elimIDiag s d e a = 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimIDiag_last
statement:
lemma elimIDiag_last (s d : Fin k → ℝ) {m : ℕ} (e : Fin m → Fin k) :
    elimIDiag s d e (Fin.last m) = 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimIDiag_nonneg
statement:
lemma elimIDiag_nonneg (s : Fin k → ℝ) (d : Fin k → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (hd : ∀ i, 0 ≤ d i) {m : ℕ} (e : Fin m → Fin k)
    (a : Fin m.succ) : 0 ≤ elimIDiag s d e a

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimKernelMinorZY_eq_scaled
statement:
lemma elimKernelMinorZY_eq_scaled (t : Fin k → ℝ) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i)
    (xval : ℝ) {m : ℕ} (e : Fin m → Fin k) (jidx : Fin k) (a b : Fin m.succ) :
    elimKernelMinorZY t xval e jidx a b =
      (if a = Fin.last m then (1 : ℝ) else t (elimSnoc e jidx a) ^ 2) *
        truncatedSquare (elimRowArg t xval e jidx) (elimColArg t e jidx) a b

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimKernelZZ_eq_truncated
statement:
lemma elimKernelZZ_eq_truncated (t : Fin k → ℝ) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i)
    (a b : Fin k) :
    elimKernelZZ t a b =
      t a ^ 2 * truncatedSquare (fun i ↦ -1 / t i) t a b

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimPivot_pos
statement:
lemma elimPivot_pos (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j) (j : Fin k) :
    0 < elimPivot s t ρ x j

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimPivot_succ
statement:
lemma elimPivot_succ (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)
    {m : ℕ} (hm : m + 1 ≤ k) :
    elimPivot s t ρ x ⟨m, Nat.lt_of_succ_le hm⟩ =
      schurComplementEntry (elimZLead s t ρ x hm) Fin.castSucc
        (Fin.last m) (Fin.last m)

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimRes_eq_pivot
statement:
lemma elimRes_eq_pivot (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ) (j : Fin k) :
    elimRes s t ρ x j (idxZ j) = elimPivot s t ρ x j

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimRes_idxZ
statement:
lemma elimRes_idxZ (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ) (j β : Fin k) :
    elimRes s t ρ x j (idxZ β) =
      schurComplementEntry
        ((M (Xconfig s t ρ x)).submatrix (idxZ (p := p)) (idxZ (p := p)))
        (Fin.castLE (Nat.le_of_lt j.isLt)) β j

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimRes_succ
statement:
lemma elimRes_succ (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)
    {m : ℕ} (hm : m + 1 ≤ k) (α : ConfigIdx k p) :
    elimRes s t ρ x ⟨m, Nat.lt_of_succ_le hm⟩ α =
      elimColZLead s t ρ x hm α (Fin.last m) -
        elimColZLead s t ρ x (Nat.le_of_succ_le hm) α ⬝ᵥ
          (elimZLead s t ρ x (Nat.le_of_succ_le hm))⁻¹ *ᵥ
            fun i => elimZLead s t ρ x hm i.castSucc (Fin.last m)

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimRowArg_monotone
statement:
lemma elimRowArg_monotone (t : Fin k → ℝ) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i) (hmono : Monotone t)
    (xval : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ xval) {m : ℕ} {e : Fin m → Fin k} (he : Monotone e)
    {jidx : Fin k} (hj : ∀ i, e i ≤ jidx) :
    Monotone (elimRowArg t xval e jidx)

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimRowY_castSucc
statement:

name: BollobasNikiforov.gram_inv_castSucc_step
statement:
lemma gram_inv_castSucc_step {m : ℕ}
    (Z : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ) (hZ : Z.PosDef)
    (Pα Pβ : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) :
    Pα ⬝ᵥ (Z⁻¹ *ᵥ Pβ) =
      (fun i : Fin m => Pα i.castSucc) ⬝ᵥ
          ((Z.submatrix Fin.castSucc Fin.castSucc)⁻¹ *ᵥ
            fun i : Fin m => Pβ i.castSucc) +
        (1 / schurComplementEntry Z Fin.castSucc (Fin.last m) (Fin.last m)) *
          (Pα (Fin.last m) -
            (fun i : Fin m => Pα i.castSucc) ⬝ᵥ
              ((Z.submatrix Fin.castSucc Fin.castSucc)⁻¹ *ᵥ
                fun i : Fin m => Z i.castSucc (Fin.last m))) *
          (Pβ (Fin.last m) -
            (fun i : Fin m => Pβ i.castSucc) ⬝ᵥ
              ((Z.submatrix Fin.castSucc Fin.castSucc)⁻¹ *ᵥ
                fun i : Fin m => Z i.castSucc (Fin.last m)))

name: BollobasNikiforov.mulVec_sum_castSucc
statement:
lemma mulVec_sum_castSucc {m : ℕ} (Z : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ)
    (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (i : Fin m) :
    (Z *ᵥ x) i.castSucc =
      ((Z.submatrix Fin.castSucc Fin.castSucc) *ᵥ fun j => x j.castSucc) i +
        Z i.castSucc (Fin.last m) * x (Fin.last m)

name: BollobasNikiforov.mulVec_sum_last
statement:
lemma mulVec_sum_last {m : ℕ} (Z : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ)
    (x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) :
    (Z *ᵥ x) (Fin.last m) =
      (fun i : Fin m => Z (Fin.last m) i.castSucc) ⬝ᵥ (fun j => x j.castSucc) +
        Z (Fin.last m) (Fin.last m) * x (Fin.last m)

name: BollobasNikiforov.mul_fin_one_apply

lemma mul_inv_of_isUnit_real {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]

name: BollobasNikiforov.schurComplementEntry_eq_minor_div_det
statement:
lemma schurComplementEntry_eq_minor_div_det (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (e : Fin r → ι)
    (_he : e.Injective) {α j : ι} (_hα : α ∉ Set.range e) (_hj : j ∉ Set.range e)
    (hdet : (A.submatrix e e).det ≠ 0) :
    schurComplementEntry A e α j =
      (A.submatrix (Fin.snoc e α) (Fin.snoc e j)).det / (A.submatrix e e).det

name: BollobasNikiforov.schurComplementEntry_eq_of_col
BollobasNikiforov.schurComplementEntry_eq_of_row
BollobasNikiforov.schurComplementEntry_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
lemma schurComplementEntry_eq_zero_of_mem {n : Type*}
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (e : Fin r → n) (hU : IsUnit (A.submatrix e e))
    (i : Fin r) (j : n) :
    schurComplementEntry A e (e i) j = 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.schurComplementEntry_one
statement:
lemma schurComplementEntry_one (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (q α j : ι) :
    schurComplementEntry A (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ q) α j =
      A α j -
        A α q * ((A.submatrix (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ q) (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ q))⁻¹ 0 0) *
          A q j

name: BollobasNikiforov.schurComplementEntry_one_div
statement:
lemma schurComplementEntry_one_div (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (q α j : ι) (hq : A q q ≠ 0) :
    schurComplementEntry A (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ q) α j =
      A α j - A α q * A q j / A q q

name: BollobasNikiforov.schurComplementEntry_submatrix
statement:
lemma schurComplementEntry_submatrix {n : Type*}
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (f : n → ι) (e : Fin r → n) (a b : n) :
    schurComplementEntry (A.submatrix f f) e a b =
      schurComplementEntry A (f ∘ e) (f a) (f b)

name: BollobasNikiforov.snoc_eq_elim_comp_finSumFinEquiv_symm
statement:
lemma snoc_eq_elim_comp_finSumFinEquiv_symm (e : Fin r → ι) (x : ι) :
    Fin.snoc e x =
      Sum.elim e (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ x) ∘ (finSumFinEquiv (m := r) (n := 1)).symm

name: BollobasNikiforov.submatrix_elim_eq_fromBlocks
statement:
lemma submatrix_elim_eq_fromBlocks (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (e : Fin r → ι) (α j : ι) :
    A.submatrix (Sum.elim e fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ α) (Sum.elim e fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ j) =
      fromBlocks (A.submatrix e e) (A.submatrix e fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ j)
        (A.submatrix (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ α) e)
        (A.submatrix (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ α) fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ j)

name: BollobasNikiforov.vecMulVec_div_sqrt
statement:
lemma vecMulVec_div_sqrt {n : Type*} (v : n → ℝ) {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d) :
    vecMulVec (fun i => v i / Real.sqrt d) (fun i => v i / Real.sqrt d) =

lemma zGram_posSemidef (s t : Fin k → ℝ) :

name: BollobasNikiforov.FF_y_y

statement:
lemma FF_z0_y (j : Fin p) :

lemma FF_z0_z (i : Fin k) :

lemma FF_z_y (i : Fin k) (j : Fin p) :

name: BollobasNikiforov.MX_y_y_diag
statement:
lemma MX_y_y_diag (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) (j : Fin p) :
    M (Xconfig s t ρ x) (idxY j) (idxY j) =
      ρ j * ρ j * (1 + x j * x j) ^ 2 +

name: BollobasNikiforov.M_Xconfig_symm
statement:
lemma M_Xconfig_symm (α β : ConfigIdx k p) :

name: BollobasNikiforov.M_eq_configF_mul_transpose_add_configL
statement:
lemma M_eq_configF_mul_transpose_add_configL (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i)
    (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j) (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) :
    M (Xconfig s t ρ x) =
      configF s t ρ x * (configF s t ρ x)ᵀ + configL s t ρ x

name: BollobasNikiforov.M_eq_elimC0_add_C1_add_Lred
statement:
lemma M_eq_elimC0_add_C1_add_Lred (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i)
    (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j) (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) (hγ : 0 < configγ s t ρ x) :
    M (Xconfig s t ρ x) =
      elimC0 s t ρ x +
        extendByZeroT (k := k) (configC1 s t ρ x) +
          extendByZeroT (k := k) (configLred s t ρ x hs hρ hγ)

name: BollobasNikiforov.Vvec_eq_e0_add_sum
statement:
lemma Vvec_eq_e0_add_sum (q : Fin k → ℝ) :
    Vvec t q = e (0 : Fin 3) + ∑ i, q i • v (t i)

name: BollobasNikiforov.Xconfig_y_y
statement:
lemma Xconfig_y_y (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ) (j ℓ : Fin p) :
    Xconfig s t ρ x (idxY j) (idxY ℓ) =
      Real.sqrt (ρ j) * Real.sqrt (ρ ℓ) * (x j * x ℓ + 1)

name: BollobasNikiforov.b_dot_b
statement: lemma b_dot_b (x₁ x₂ : ℝ) : b x₁ ⬝ᵥ b x₂ = (1 + x₁ * x₂) ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.configC1_eq_conj
statement:
lemma configC1_eq_conj (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (hγ : 0 < configγ s t ρ x) :
    configC1 s t ρ x =
      configU s t ρ x hs hρ hγ *
        ((1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) +
            (configFE s t ρ x)ᵀ * (configLEE s t ρ x)⁻¹ * configFE s t ρ x)⁻¹ *
        (configU s t ρ x hs hρ hγ)ᵀ

name: BollobasNikiforov.configEEmbed_eq_elimEEmbed
statement:
lemma configEEmbed_eq_elimEEmbed :
    (configEEmbed : Option (Fin k) → ConfigIdx k p) = elimEEmbed

name: BollobasNikiforov.configET_elim_factor
statement:
lemma configET_elim_factor (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i)
    (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j) (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) (hγ : 0 < configγ s t ρ x) :
    elimEE s t ρ x * (configLEE s t ρ x)⁻¹ * configLET s t ρ x +
        configFE s t ρ x * (configU s t ρ x hs hρ hγ)ᵀ =
      elimET s t ρ x

name: BollobasNikiforov.configFE_none
statement: lemma configFE_none : configFE s t ρ x none = e (0 : Fin 3)

name: BollobasNikiforov.configFE_some
statement:
lemma configFE_some (i : Fin k) :
    configFE s t ρ x (some i) = s i • v (t i)

name: BollobasNikiforov.configFE_transpose_mulVec_w
statement:
lemma configFE_transpose_mulVec_w :
    (configFE s t ρ x)ᵀ *ᵥ configW t ρ x =
      Vvec t (configQ s t ρ x)

name: BollobasNikiforov.configFT_apply
statement:
lemma configFT_apply (j : Fin p) :
    configFT s t ρ x j = ρ j • b (x j)

name: BollobasNikiforov.configF_mul_transpose_apply
statement:
lemma configF_mul_transpose_apply (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)
    (α β : ConfigIdx k p) :
    (configF s t ρ x * (configF s t ρ x)ᵀ) α β =
      configF s t ρ x α ⬝ᵥ configF s t ρ x β

name: BollobasNikiforov.configF_y
statement:
lemma configF_y (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ) (j : Fin p) :
    configF s t ρ x (idxY j) = ρ j • b (x j)

name: BollobasNikiforov.configF_z
statement:
lemma configF_z (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ) (i : Fin k) :
    configF s t ρ x (idxZ i) = s i • v (t i)

name: BollobasNikiforov.configF_z0
statement:
lemma configF_z0 (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ) :
    configF s t ρ x idxZ0 = e (0 : Fin 3)

name: BollobasNikiforov.configH_eq_sum_truncSq
statement:
lemma configH_eq_sum_truncSq (t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ) (i : Fin k) :
    configH t ρ x i = ∑ j, ρ j * truncSq (t i) (x j)

name: BollobasNikiforov.configIdx_cases
statement:
lemma configIdx_cases {P : ConfigIdx k p → Prop} (α : ConfigIdx k p)
    (h0 : P idxZ0) (hz : ∀ i, P (idxZ i)) (hy : ∀ j, P (idxY j)) : P α

name: BollobasNikiforov.configInvFE_none
statement:
lemma configInvFE_none (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (hγ : 0 < configγ s t ρ x) :
    configInvFE s t ρ x none =
      (configγ s t ρ x)⁻¹ • Vvec t (configQ s t ρ x)

name: BollobasNikiforov.configInvFE_some
statement:
lemma configInvFE_some (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (hγ : 0 < configγ s t ρ x) (i : Fin k) :
    configInvFE s t ρ x (some i) =
      (configD t ρ x i)⁻¹ •
        (v (t i) + (configγ s t ρ x)⁻¹ • Vvec t (configQ s t ρ x))

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLEE_dot
statement:
lemma configLEE_dot (v : Option (Fin k) → ℝ) :
    v ⬝ᵥ configLEE s t ρ x *ᵥ v =
      configσ s * v none ^ 2 - 2 * v none * ∑ i, s i * v (some i) +
        ∑ i, s i * configD t ρ x i * v (some i) ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLEE_inv
statement:
lemma configLEE_inv (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (hγ : 0 < configγ s t ρ x) :
    (configLEE s t ρ x)⁻¹ =
      configLEEInvDiag s t ρ x +
        (configγ s t ρ x)⁻¹ • vecMulVec (configW t ρ x) (configW t ρ x)

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLEE_invDiag_mul_FE_none
statement:
lemma configLEE_invDiag_mul_FE_none :
    (configLEEInvDiag s t ρ x * configFE s t ρ x) none = (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ)

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLEE_invDiag_mul_FE_some
statement:
lemma configLEE_invDiag_mul_FE_some (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (i : Fin k) :
    (configLEEInvDiag s t ρ x * configFE s t ρ x) (some i) =
      (configD t ρ x i)⁻¹ • v (t i)

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLEE_inv_transpose
statement:
lemma configLEE_inv_transpose :
    ((configLEE s t ρ x)⁻¹)ᵀ = (configLEE s t ρ x)⁻¹

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLEE_isHermitian
statement: lemma configLEE_isHermitian : (configLEE s t ρ x).IsHermitian

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLEE_isSymm
statement: lemma configLEE_isSymm : (configLEE s t ρ x).IsSymm

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLEE_isUnit
statement:
lemma configLEE_isUnit (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (hγ : 0 < configγ s t ρ x) : IsUnit (configLEE s t ρ x)

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLEE_mulVec_none
statement:
lemma configLEE_mulVec_none (v : Option (Fin k) → ℝ) :
    (configLEE s t ρ x *ᵥ v) none =
      configσ s * v none - ∑ i, s i * v (some i)

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLEE_mulVec_one_add
statement:
lemma configLEE_mulVec_one_add (a : Option (Fin k)) :
    (configLEE s t ρ x *ᵥ (1 : Option (Fin k) → ℝ)) a +
        (configLET s t ρ x *ᵥ (1 : Fin p → ℝ)) a =
      (configL s t ρ x *ᵥ (1 : ConfigIdx k p → ℝ)) (configEEmbed a)

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLEE_mulVec_some
statement:
lemma configLEE_mulVec_some (v : Option (Fin k) → ℝ) (i : Fin k) :
    (configLEE s t ρ x *ᵥ v) (some i) =
      -s i * v none + s i * configD t ρ x i * v (some i)

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLEE_mulVec_w
statement:
lemma configLEE_mulVec_w (_hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j) :
    configLEE s t ρ x *ᵥ configW t ρ x =
      fun a => if a = none then configγ s t ρ x else 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLEE_mul_invDiag_apply
statement:
lemma configLEE_mul_invDiag_apply (a b : Option (Fin k)) :
    (configLEE s t ρ x * configLEEInvDiag s t ρ x) a b =
      match b with
      | none => 0
      | some j => configLEE s t ρ x a (some j) * (s j * configD t ρ x j)⁻¹

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLEE_mul_nonsing_inv
statement:
lemma configLEE_mul_nonsing_inv (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (hγ : 0 < configγ s t ρ x) :
    configLEE s t ρ x * (configLEE s t ρ x)⁻¹ = 1

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLEE_none_none
statement: lemma configLEE_none_none : configLEE s t ρ x none none = configσ s

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLEE_none_some
statement:
lemma configLEE_none_some (i : Fin k) :
    configLEE s t ρ x none (some i) = -s i

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLEE_nonsing_inv_mul
statement:
lemma configLEE_nonsing_inv_mul (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (hγ : 0 < configγ s t ρ x) :
    (configLEE s t ρ x)⁻¹ * configLEE s t ρ x = 1

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLEE_posDef
statement:
lemma configLEE_posDef (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (hγ : 0 < configγ s t ρ x) :
    (configLEE s t ρ x).PosDef

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLEE_posSemidef
statement:
lemma configLEE_posSemidef (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j) :
    (configLEE s t ρ x).PosSemidef

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLEE_quad
statement:
lemma configLEE_quad (v : Option (Fin k) → ℝ) :
    v ⬝ᵥ configLEE s t ρ x *ᵥ v =
      ∑ i, s i * (v none - v (some i)) ^ 2 +
        ∑ i, s i * configH t ρ x i * v (some i) ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLEE_some_none
statement:
lemma configLEE_some_none (i : Fin k) :
    configLEE s t ρ x (some i) none = -s i

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLEE_some_some
statement:
lemma configLEE_some_some (i h : Fin k) :
    configLEE s t ρ x (some i) (some h) =
      if i = h then s i * configD t ρ x i else 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLET_eq_transpose
statement: lemma configLET_eq_transpose : configLET s t ρ x = (configLTE s t ρ x)ᵀ

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLET_none
statement: lemma configLET_none (j : Fin p) : configLET s t ρ x none j = 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLET_some
statement:
lemma configLET_some (i : Fin k) (j : Fin p) :
    configLET s t ρ x (some i) j = -(s i * ρ j * truncSq (t i) (x j))

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLTE_mul_InvFE
statement:
lemma configLTE_mul_InvFE (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (hγ : 0 < configγ s t ρ x) (j : Fin p) :
    (configLTE s t ρ x * configInvFE s t ρ x) j =
      -ρ j •
        (∑ i, (configQ s t ρ x i * truncSq (t i) (x j)) • v (t i) +
          (h t (configQ s t ρ x) (x j) / configγ s t ρ x) •
            Vvec t (configQ s t ρ x))

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLTE_none
statement: lemma configLTE_none (j : Fin p) : configLTE s t ρ x j none = 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLTE_some
statement:
lemma configLTE_some (j : Fin p) (i : Fin k) :
    configLTE s t ρ x j (some i) = -(s i * ρ j * truncSq (t i) (x j))

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLTT_apply
statement:
lemma configLTT_apply (j ℓ : Fin p) :
    configLTT s t ρ x j ℓ =
      if j = ℓ then ∑ i, s i * ρ j * truncSq (t i) (x j) else 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLTT_mulVec_one_add
statement:
lemma configLTT_mulVec_one_add (j : Fin p) :
    (configLTT s t ρ x *ᵥ (1 : Fin p → ℝ)) j +
        (configLTE s t ρ x *ᵥ (1 : Option (Fin k) → ℝ)) j =
      (configL s t ρ x *ᵥ (1 : ConfigIdx k p → ℝ)) (idxY j)

name: BollobasNikiforov.configL_apply
statement:
lemma configL_apply (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)
    (α β : ConfigIdx k p) :
    configL s t ρ x α β =
      ∑ i, s i *
          vecMulVec (e (idxZ0 : ConfigIdx k p) - e (idxZ (p := p) i))
            (e (idxZ0 : ConfigIdx k p) - e (idxZ (p := p) i)) α β
        + ∑ i, ∑ j, (s i * ρ j * truncSq (t i) (x j)) *
            vecMulVec (e (idxZ (p := p) i) - e (idxY (k := k) j))
              (e (idxZ (p := p) i) - e (idxY (k := k) j)) α β

name: BollobasNikiforov.configL_mulVec_one
statement: lemma configL_mulVec_one : configL s t ρ x *ᵥ (1 : ConfigIdx k p → ℝ) = 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.configL_posSemidef
statement:
lemma configL_posSemidef (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j) :
    (configL s t ρ x).PosSemidef

name: BollobasNikiforov.configL_symm
statement:
lemma configL_symm (α β : ConfigIdx k p) :
    configL s t ρ x α β = configL s t ρ x β α

name: BollobasNikiforov.configL_y_y
statement:
lemma configL_y_y (j ℓ : Fin p) :
    configL s t ρ x (idxY j) (idxY ℓ) =
      if j = ℓ then ∑ i, s i * ρ j * truncSq (t i) (x j) else 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.configL_z0_y
statement: lemma configL_z0_y (j : Fin p) : configL s t ρ x idxZ0 (idxY j) = 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.configL_z0_z
statement: lemma configL_z0_z (i : Fin k) : configL s t ρ x idxZ0 (idxZ i) = -s i

name: BollobasNikiforov.configL_z0_z0
statement: lemma configL_z0_z0 : configL s t ρ x idxZ0 idxZ0 = configσ s

name: BollobasNikiforov.configL_z_y
statement:
lemma configL_z_y (i : Fin k) (j : Fin p) :
    configL s t ρ x (idxZ i) (idxY j) = -(s i * ρ j * truncSq (t i) (x j))

name: BollobasNikiforov.configL_z_z
statement:
lemma configL_z_z (i h : Fin k) :
    configL s t ρ x (idxZ i) (idxZ h) =
      if i = h then s i * configD t ρ x i else 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLredWeights_nonneg
statement:
lemma configLredWeights_nonneg (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (hγ : 0 < configγ s t ρ x) (α β : ConfigIdx k p) (hαβ : α < β) :
    0 ≤ configLredWeights s t ρ x hs hρ hγ α β

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLredWeights_y_y
statement:
lemma configLredWeights_y_y (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (hγ : 0 < configγ s t ρ x) (j ℓ : Fin p) :
    configLredWeights s t ρ x hs hρ hγ (idxY j) (idxY ℓ) =
      if j < ℓ then -(configLred s t ρ x hs hρ hγ j ℓ) else 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLred_eq_weightedLaplacian
statement:
lemma configLred_eq_weightedLaplacian (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (hγ : 0 < configγ s t ρ x) :
    configLred s t ρ x hs hρ hγ =
      ∑ j, ∑ ℓ,
        (if j < ℓ then -(configLred s t ρ x hs hρ hγ j ℓ) else 0) •
          vecMulVec (e j - e ℓ) (e j - e ℓ)

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLred_isSymm
statement:
lemma configLred_isSymm (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (hγ : 0 < configγ s t ρ x) :
    (configLred s t ρ x hs hρ hγ).IsSymm

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLred_mulVec_one
statement:
lemma configLred_mulVec_one (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (hγ : 0 < configγ s t ρ x) :
    configLred s t ρ x hs hρ hγ *ᵥ (1 : Fin p → ℝ) = 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLred_of_ne
statement:
lemma configLred_of_ne (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (hγ : 0 < configγ s t ρ x) {j ℓ : Fin p} (hjl : j ≠ ℓ) :
    -(configLred s t ρ x hs hρ hγ j ℓ) =
      ρ j * ρ ℓ *
        (∑ i, configQ s t ρ x i * truncSq (t i) (x j) * truncSq (t i) (x ℓ) +
          h t (configQ s t ρ x) (x j) * h t (configQ s t ρ x) (x ℓ) /
            configγ s t ρ x)

name: BollobasNikiforov.configLred_of_ne_nonneg
statement:
lemma configLred_of_ne_nonneg (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (hγ : 0 < configγ s t ρ x) {j ℓ : Fin p} (hjl : j ≠ ℓ) :
    0 ≤ -(configLred s t ρ x hs hρ hγ j ℓ)

name: BollobasNikiforov.configQ_pos
statement:
lemma configQ_pos (s t : Fin k → ℝ) {ρ : Fin p → ℝ} (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (x : Fin p → ℝ) {i : Fin k} (hsi : 0 < s i) :
    0 < configQ s t ρ x i

name: BollobasNikiforov.configTE_elim_factor
statement:
lemma configTE_elim_factor (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i)
    (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j) (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) (hγ : 0 < configγ s t ρ x) :
    configLTE s t ρ x * (configLEE s t ρ x)⁻¹ * elimEE s t ρ x +
        configU s t ρ x hs hρ hγ * (configFE s t ρ x)ᵀ =
      elimTE s t ρ x

name: BollobasNikiforov.configU_apply
statement:
lemma configU_apply (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (hγ : 0 < configγ s t ρ x) (j : Fin p) :
    configU s t ρ x hs hρ hγ j =
      ρ j • U t (configQ s t ρ x) (configγ s t ρ x) (x j)

name: BollobasNikiforov.configγ_eq_schur
statement:
lemma configγ_eq_schur (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j) :
    configσ s - s ⬝ᵥ (diagonal fun i => s i * configD t ρ x i)⁻¹ *ᵥ s =
      configγ s t ρ x

name: BollobasNikiforov.configγ_eq_sum
statement:
lemma configγ_eq_sum (s t : Fin k → ℝ) {ρ : Fin p → ℝ} (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (x : Fin p → ℝ) :
    configγ s t ρ x = ∑ i, s i * configH t ρ x i / configD t ρ x i

name: BollobasNikiforov.configγ_nonneg
statement:
lemma configγ_nonneg (s t : Fin k → ℝ) {ρ : Fin p → ℝ} (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (x : Fin p → ℝ) (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) :
    0 ≤ configγ s t ρ x

name: BollobasNikiforov.e0_dot_b
statement: lemma e0_dot_b (xj : ℝ) : e (0 : Fin 3) ⬝ᵥ b xj = xj ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.e0_dot_e0
statement: lemma e0_dot_e0 : e (0 : Fin 3) ⬝ᵥ e (0 : Fin 3) = 1

name: BollobasNikiforov.e0_dot_v
statement: lemma e0_dot_v (ti : ℝ) : e (0 : Fin 3) ⬝ᵥ v ti = 1

name: BollobasNikiforov.edge_z0
statement:
lemma edge_z0 (i : Fin k) (α β : ConfigIdx k p) :
    vecMulVec (e (idxZ0 : ConfigIdx k p) - e (idxZ (p := p) i))
      (e (idxZ0 : ConfigIdx k p) - e (idxZ (p := p) i)) α β =
      (if α = idxZ0 then (1 : ℝ) else if α = idxZ i then -1 else 0) *
      (if β = idxZ0 then (1 : ℝ) else if β = idxZ i then -1 else 0)

name: BollobasNikiforov.edge_zy
statement:
lemma edge_zy (i : Fin k) (j : Fin p) (α β : ConfigIdx k p) :
    vecMulVec (e (idxZ (p := p) i) - e (idxY (k := k) j))
      (e (idxZ (p := p) i) - e (idxY (k := k) j)) α β =
      (if α = idxZ i then (1 : ℝ) else if α = idxY j then -1 else 0) *
      (if β = idxZ i then (1 : ℝ) else if β = idxY j then -1 else 0)

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimEE_eq_LEE_add_FE
statement:
lemma elimEE_eq_LEE_add_FE (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i)
    (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j) (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) :
    elimEE s t ρ x =
      configLEE s t ρ x + configFE s t ρ x * (configFE s t ρ x)ᵀ

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimEE_isUnit
statement:
lemma elimEE_isUnit (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i)
    (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j) (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) :
    IsUnit (elimEE s t ρ x)

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimEE_mul_nonsing_inv
statement:
lemma elimEE_mul_nonsing_inv (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i)
    (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j) (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) :
    elimEE s t ρ x * (elimEE s t ρ x)⁻¹ = 1

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimEE_nonsing_inv_mul
statement:
lemma elimEE_nonsing_inv_mul (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i)
    (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j) (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) :
    (elimEE s t ρ x)⁻¹ * elimEE s t ρ x = 1

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimET_eq_LET_add_FE_FT
statement:
lemma elimET_eq_LET_add_FE_FT (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i)
    (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j) (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) :
    elimET s t ρ x =
      configLET s t ρ x + configFE s t ρ x * (configFT s t ρ x)ᵀ

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimSchurR_eq_C1_add_Lred
statement:
lemma elimSchurR_eq_C1_add_Lred (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i)
    (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j) (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) (hγ : 0 < configγ s t ρ x) :
    elimSchurR s t ρ x =
      configC1 s t ρ x + configLred s t ρ x hs hρ hγ

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimSchurR_eq_woodbury
statement:
lemma elimSchurR_eq_woodbury (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i)
    (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j) (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) (hγ : 0 < configγ s t ρ x) :
    elimSchurR s t ρ x =
      configLred s t ρ x hs hρ hγ +
        configU s t ρ x hs hρ hγ *
          ((1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) +
              (configFE s t ρ x)ᵀ * (configLEE s t ρ x)⁻¹ * configFE s t ρ x)⁻¹ *
          (configU s t ρ x hs hρ hγ)ᵀ

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimTE_eq_LTE_add_FT_FE
statement:
lemma elimTE_eq_LTE_add_FT_FE (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i)
    (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j) (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) :
    elimTE s t ρ x =
      configLTE s t ρ x + configFT s t ρ x * (configFE s t ρ x)ᵀ

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimTT_eq_LTT_add_FT_FT
statement:
lemma elimTT_eq_LTT_add_FT_FT (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i)
    (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j) (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) :
    elimTT s t ρ x =
      configLTT s t ρ x + configFT s t ρ x * (configFT s t ρ x)ᵀ

name: BollobasNikiforov.eq_of_lt_pair
statement:
lemma eq_of_lt_pair {a b c d : n} (hab : a < b) (hcd : c < d)
    (h : ({a, b} : Set n) = {c, d}) : a = c ∧ b = d

name: BollobasNikiforov.exists_split_of_le_sum
statement:
lemma exists_split_of_le_sum {q : ℕ} (bound : Fin q → ℝ) (h : ℝ)
    (h0 : 0 ≤ h) (hb : ∀ a, 0 ≤ bound a) (hle : h ≤ ∑ a, bound a) :
    ∃ alloc : Fin q → ℝ,
      (∀ a, 0 ≤ alloc a) ∧ (∀ a, alloc a ≤ bound a) ∧ ∑ a, alloc a = h

name: BollobasNikiforov.extendByZeroT_add
statement:
lemma extendByZeroT_add (A B : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ) :
    extendByZeroT (k := k) (A + B) =
      extendByZeroT (k := k) A + extendByZeroT (k := k) B

name: BollobasNikiforov.extendByZeroT_configLred_eq_sum
statement:
lemma extendByZeroT_configLred_eq_sum (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (hγ : 0 < configγ s t ρ x) :
    extendByZeroT (k := k) (configLred s t ρ x hs hρ hγ) =
      ∑ j, ∑ ℓ,
        (if j < ℓ then -(configLred s t ρ x hs hρ hγ j ℓ) else 0) •
          vecMulVec (e (idxY (k := k) j) - e (idxY ℓ))
            (e (idxY (k := k) j) - e (idxY ℓ))

name: BollobasNikiforov.extendByZeroT_isSymm
statement:
lemma extendByZeroT_isSymm {R : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ} (hR : R.IsSymm) :
    (extendByZeroT (k := k) R).IsSymm

name: BollobasNikiforov.extendByZeroT_mulVec_one
statement:
lemma extendByZeroT_mulVec_one (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ)
    (hA : A *ᵥ (1 : Fin p → ℝ) = 0) :
    extendByZeroT (k := k) A *ᵥ (1 : ConfigIdx k p → ℝ) = 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.extendByZeroT_smul
statement:
lemma extendByZeroT_smul (c : ℝ) (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ) :
    extendByZeroT (k := k) (c • A) = c • extendByZeroT (k := k) A

name: BollobasNikiforov.extendByZeroT_sum
statement:
lemma extendByZeroT_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (f : ι → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ) :
    extendByZeroT (k := k) (∑ i, f i) = ∑ i, extendByZeroT (k := k) (f i)

name: BollobasNikiforov.extendByZeroT_vecMulVec_sub
statement:
lemma extendByZeroT_vecMulVec_sub (j ℓ : Fin p) :
    extendByZeroT (k := k) (vecMulVec (e j - e ℓ) (e j - e ℓ)) =
      vecMulVec (e (idxY (k := k) j) - e (idxY ℓ))
        (e (idxY (k := k) j) - e (idxY ℓ))

name: BollobasNikiforov.extend_configLred_eq_weightedLaplacian
statement:
lemma extend_configLred_eq_weightedLaplacian (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i)
    (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j) (hγ : 0 < configγ s t ρ x) :
    extendByZeroT (k := k) (configLred s t ρ x hs hρ hγ) =
      weightedLaplacian (configLredWeights s t ρ x hs hρ hγ)

name: BollobasNikiforov.extend_configLred_offDiag
statement:
lemma extend_configLred_offDiag (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (hγ : 0 < configγ s t ρ x) {α β : ConfigIdx k p} (hlt : α < β) :
    extendByZeroT (k := k) (configLred s t ρ x hs hρ hγ) α β =
      -configLredWeights s t ρ x hs hρ hγ α β

name: BollobasNikiforov.fromBlocks_add_mul_transpose
statement:
lemma fromBlocks_add_mul_transpose {ε τ : Type*}
    (LEE : Matrix ε ε R) (Lred : Matrix τ τ R)
    (FE : Matrix ε κ R) (U : Matrix τ κ R) :
    fromRows FE U * (fromRows FE U)ᵀ + fromBlocks LEE 0 0 Lred =
      fromBlocks (LEE + FE * FEᵀ) (FE * Uᵀ) (U * FEᵀ) (Lred + U * Uᵀ)

name: BollobasNikiforov.idxY_eq_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma idxY_eq_iff {j ℓ : Fin p} :
    (idxY (k := k) j : ConfigIdx k p) = idxY ℓ ↔ j = ℓ

name: BollobasNikiforov.idxY_injective
statement:
lemma idxY_injective {j ℓ : Fin p} (h : (idxY (k := k) j : ConfigIdx k p) = idxY ℓ) :
    j = ℓ

name: BollobasNikiforov.idxY_injective_fn
statement: lemma idxY_injective_fn : Function.Injective (idxY (k := k) (p := p))

name: BollobasNikiforov.idxY_lt_idxY_iff
statement:
lemma idxY_lt_idxY_iff {j ℓ : Fin p} :
    (idxY (k := k) j : ConfigIdx k p) < idxY ℓ ↔ j < ℓ

name: BollobasNikiforov.idxY_ne_idxZ
statement:
@[simp] lemma idxY_ne_idxZ (i : Fin k) (j : Fin p) :
    (idxY (k := k) j : ConfigIdx k p) ≠ idxZ i

name: BollobasNikiforov.idxY_ne_idxZ0
statement:
@[simp] lemma idxY_ne_idxZ0 (j : Fin p) :
    (idxY (k := k) j : ConfigIdx k p) ≠ idxZ0

name: BollobasNikiforov.idxZ_eq_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma idxZ_eq_iff {i h : Fin k} :
    (idxZ (p := p) i : ConfigIdx k p) = idxZ h ↔ i = h

name: BollobasNikiforov.idxZ_injective
statement:
lemma idxZ_injective {i h : Fin k} (heq : (idxZ (p := p) i : ConfigIdx k p) = idxZ h) :
    i = h

name: BollobasNikiforov.idxZ_ne_idxZ0
statement:
@[simp] lemma idxZ_ne_idxZ0 (i : Fin k) :
    (idxZ (p := p) i : ConfigIdx k p) ≠ idxZ0

name: BollobasNikiforov.interpolate_pair
statement:
lemma interpolate_pair {p : n → ℝ} {i j : n} {h t : ℝ}
    (ht : t * (p i * p j) = h) :
    (1 - t) • vecMulVec p p +
        t • (vecMulVec p p + (p i * p j) • vecMulVec (e i - e j) (e i - e j)) =
      vecMulVec p p + h • vecMulVec (e i - e j) (e i - e j)

name: BollobasNikiforov.isCompletelyPositive_add_sum_pairs
statement:
lemma isCompletelyPositive_add_sum_pairs {C : Matrix n n ℝ} (hC : IsCompletelyPositive C)
    (ℓ : n → n → ℝ) (s : Finset (n × n)) (hs : s ⊆ offDiagLt)
    (hℓ : ∀ p ∈ s, 0 ≤ ℓ p.1 p.2) (hslack : ∀ p ∈ s, ℓ p.1 p.2 ≤ C p.1 p.2) :
    IsCompletelyPositive
      (C + ∑ p ∈ s, ℓ p.1 p.2 • vecMulVec (e p.1 - e p.2) (e p.1 - e p.2))

name: BollobasNikiforov.isCompletelyPositive_configC1
statement:
lemma isCompletelyPositive_configC1 (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i)
    (hmono : Monotone t) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j) (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j)
    (hγ : 0 < configγ s t ρ x) :
    IsCompletelyPositive (configC1 s t ρ x)

name: BollobasNikiforov.isCompletelyPositive_extendByZeroT
BollobasNikiforov.isCompletelyPositive_extend_configC1
statement:
lemma isCompletelyPositive_extend_configC1 (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i)
    (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i) (hmono : Monotone t) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) (hγ : 0 < configγ s t ρ x) :
    IsCompletelyPositive (extendByZeroT (k := k) (configC1 s t ρ x))

name: BollobasNikiforov.isCompletelyPositive_mul_conj_diagonal
BollobasNikiforov.isCompletelyPositive_of_submatrix_pad
statement:
lemma isCompletelyPositive_of_submatrix_pad {ι n : Type*} [Finite ι]
    {C : Matrix n n ℝ} {D : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {e : ι → n}
    (he : Function.Injective e)
    (hCD : ∀ a b, C (e a) (e b) = D a b)
    (hzero : ∀ i, i ∉ Set.range e → ∀ j, C i j = 0)
    (hC : C.IsSymm) (hD : IsCompletelyPositive D) :
    IsCompletelyPositive C

name: BollobasNikiforov.isCompletelyPositive_vecMulVec_add_smul_sub_single
statement:
lemma isCompletelyPositive_vecMulVec_add_smul_sub_single {p : n → ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    {i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j) {h : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ h) (hle : h ≤ p i * p j) :
    IsCompletelyPositive
      (vecMulVec p p + h • vecMulVec (e i - e j) (e i - e j))

name: BollobasNikiforov.isSymm_mulVec_one_eq_weightedLaplacian
statement:
lemma isSymm_mulVec_one_eq_weightedLaplacian
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [LinearOrder n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (hA : A.IsSymm) (h1 : A *ᵥ (1 : n → ℝ) = 0) :
    A = ∑ p, ∑ q,
      (if p < q then -(A p q) else 0) • vecMulVec (e p - e q) (e p - e q)

name: BollobasNikiforov.isUnit_one_add_configFE_conj
statement:
lemma isUnit_one_add_configFE_conj (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (hγ : 0 < configγ s t ρ x) :
    IsUnit
      ((1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) +
        (configFE s t ρ x)ᵀ * (configLEE s t ρ x)⁻¹ * configFE s t ρ x)

name: BollobasNikiforov.mem_offDiagLt
statement: lemma mem_offDiagLt {i j : n} : (i, j) ∈ offDiagLt ↔ i < j

name: BollobasNikiforov.mul_one_sub_conj
statement:
lemma mul_one_sub_conj {ε τ : Type*} [Fintype ε] [DecidableEq ε]
    (U : Matrix τ κ R) (FE : Matrix ε κ R) (A : Matrix ε ε R) :
    U * ((1 : Matrix κ κ R) - FEᵀ * A⁻¹ * FE) * Uᵀ =
      U * Uᵀ - U * FEᵀ * A⁻¹ * FE * Uᵀ

name: BollobasNikiforov.mul_vecMulVec
statement:
lemma mul_vecMulVec (A : Matrix (Option (Fin k)) (Option (Fin k)) ℝ)
    (u w : Option (Fin k) → ℝ) :
    A * vecMulVec u w = vecMulVec (A *ᵥ u) w

name: BollobasNikiforov.mul_vecMulVec_mul_apply
statement:
lemma mul_vecMulVec_mul_apply {m n : Type*} [Fintype n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (w : n → ℝ) (C : Matrix n m ℝ) (j ℓ : m) :
    (A * vecMulVec w w * C) j ℓ =
      (∑ a, A j a * w a) * (∑ b, w b * C b ℓ)

name: BollobasNikiforov.one_add_configFE_conj_inv
statement:
lemma one_add_configFE_conj_inv (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (hγ : 0 < configγ s t ρ x) :
    (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) +
      (configFE s t ρ x)ᵀ * (configLEE s t ρ x)⁻¹ * configFE s t ρ x =
      𝒦Mat t (configQ s t ρ x) (configγ s t ρ x)

name: BollobasNikiforov.one_sub_transpose_mul_inv_mul
statement:
lemma one_sub_transpose_mul_inv_mul (L : Matrix ι ι R) (F : Matrix ι κ R)
    (hL : IsUnit L) (hW : IsUnit (1 + Fᵀ * L⁻¹ * F)) :
    (1 : Matrix κ κ R) - Fᵀ * (L + F * Fᵀ)⁻¹ * F = (1 + Fᵀ * L⁻¹ * F)⁻¹

name: BollobasNikiforov.pairLeft_eq
statement:
lemma pairLeft_eq (p : n → ℝ) {i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    pairLeft p i j = p + p j • (e i - e j)

name: BollobasNikiforov.pairLeft_nonneg
statement: lemma pairLeft_nonneg {p : n → ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (i j : n) : 0 ≤ pairLeft p i j

name: BollobasNikiforov.pairOffDiag
statement:
lemma pairOffDiag {p q x y : n} (hpq : p ≠ q) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hpair : ({p, q} : Set n) ≠ {x, y}) :
    vecMulVec (e p - e q) (e p - e q) x y = 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.pairRight_eq
statement:
lemma pairRight_eq (p : n → ℝ) {i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    pairRight p i j = p - p i • (e i - e j)

name: BollobasNikiforov.pairRight_nonneg
statement: lemma pairRight_nonneg {p : n → ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (i j : n) : 0 ≤ pairRight p i j

name: BollobasNikiforov.rankOne_pair_identity
statement:
lemma rankOne_pair_identity {p : n → ℝ} {i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hab : 0 < p i + p j) :
    vecMulVec p p + (p i * p j) • vecMulVec (e i - e j) (e i - e j) =
      (p i / (p i + p j)) • vecMulVec (pairLeft p i j) (pairLeft p i j) +
        (p j / (p i + p j)) • vecMulVec (pairRight p i j) (pairRight p i j)

name: BollobasNikiforov.schurComplement_diag_add_mul
statement:
lemma schurComplement_diag_add_mul {ε τ : Type*} [Fintype ε] [DecidableEq ε]
    (Lred : Matrix τ τ R) (U : Matrix τ κ R) (FE : Matrix ε κ R)
    (A : Matrix ε ε R) :
    (Lred + U * Uᵀ) - U * FEᵀ * A⁻¹ * FE * Uᵀ =
      Lred + U * ((1 : Matrix κ κ R) - FEᵀ * A⁻¹ * FE) * Uᵀ

name: BollobasNikiforov.schurComplement_woodbury
statement:
lemma schurComplement_woodbury {ε τ : Type*}
    [Fintype ε] [DecidableEq ε]
    (LEE : Matrix ε ε R) (Lred : Matrix τ τ R)
    (FE : Matrix ε κ R) (U : Matrix τ κ R)
    (hLEE : IsUnit LEE) (hW : IsUnit (1 + FEᵀ * LEE⁻¹ * FE)) :
    (Lred + U * Uᵀ) - U * FEᵀ * (LEE + FE * FEᵀ)⁻¹ * FE * Uᵀ =
      Lred + U * (1 + FEᵀ * LEE⁻¹ * FE)⁻¹ * Uᵀ

name: BollobasNikiforov.schur_prod_expand
statement:
lemma schur_prod_expand {ε τ κ : Type*} [Fintype ε] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ε]
    (Z : Matrix τ ε ℝ) (EE : Matrix ε ε ℝ) (U : Matrix τ κ ℝ)
    (FE : Matrix ε κ ℝ) (Z' : Matrix ε τ ℝ)
    (hL : EE⁻¹ * EE = 1) (hR : EE * EE⁻¹ = 1) :
    (Z * EE + U * FEᵀ) * EE⁻¹ * (EE * Z' + FE * Uᵀ) =
      Z * EE * Z' + Z * FE * Uᵀ + U * FEᵀ * Z' +
        U * FEᵀ * EE⁻¹ * FE * Uᵀ

name: BollobasNikiforov.sub_edge_z0
statement:
lemma sub_edge_z0 (i : Fin k) (α : ConfigIdx k p) :
    (e (idxZ0 : ConfigIdx k p) - e (idxZ (p := p) i)) α =
      if α = idxZ0 then (1 : ℝ) else if α = idxZ i then -1 else 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.sub_edge_zy
statement:
lemma sub_edge_zy (i : Fin k) (j : Fin p) (α : ConfigIdx k p) :
    (e (idxZ (p := p) i) - e (idxY (k := k) j)) α =
      if α = idxZ i then (1 : ℝ) else if α = idxY j then -1 else 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.truncSq_neg_id
statement:
lemma truncSq_neg_id (ti xj : ℝ) :
    max (ti - xj) 0 ^ 2 = (xj - ti) ^ 2 - truncSq ti xj

name: BollobasNikiforov.v_dot_b
statement: lemma v_dot_b (ti xj : ℝ) : v ti ⬝ᵥ b xj = (xj - ti) ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.v_dot_v
statement: lemma v_dot_v (t₁ t₂ : ℝ) : v t₁ ⬝ᵥ v t₂ = (1 + t₁ * t₂) ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.vecMulVec_add_self
statement:
lemma vecMulVec_add_self (x y : n → ℝ) :
    vecMulVec (x + y) (x + y) =
      vecMulVec x x + vecMulVec x y + vecMulVec y x + vecMulVec y y

name: BollobasNikiforov.vecMulVec_smul_self
statement:
lemma vecMulVec_smul_self (c : ℝ) (x : n → ℝ) :
    vecMulVec (c • x) (c • x) = (c * c) • vecMulVec x x

name: BollobasNikiforov.vecMulVec_sub_self
statement:
lemma vecMulVec_sub_self (x y : n → ℝ) :
    vecMulVec (x - y) (x - y) =
      vecMulVec x x - vecMulVec x y - vecMulVec y x + vecMulVec y y

name: BollobasNikiforov.vecMulVec_w_mul_FE
statement:
lemma vecMulVec_w_mul_FE (a : Option (Fin k)) :
    (vecMulVec (configW t ρ x) (configW t ρ x) * configFE s t ρ x) a =
      configW t ρ x a • Vvec t (configQ s t ρ x)

name: BollobasNikiforov.weightedLaplacian_apply_of_lt
statement:
lemma weightedLaplacian_apply_of_lt (ℓ : n → n → ℝ) {i j : n} (hij : i < j) :
    weightedLaplacian ℓ i j = -ℓ i j

name: BollobasNikiforov.weightedLaplacian_eq_doubleSum
statement:
lemma weightedLaplacian_eq_doubleSum {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    [LinearOrder n] (ℓ : n → n → ℝ) :
    weightedLaplacian ℓ =
      ∑ i, ∑ j,
        (if i < j then ℓ i j else 0) • vecMulVec (e i - e j) (e i - e j)

name: BollobasNikiforov.weightedLaplacian_sum_apply_of_ne
statement:
lemma weightedLaplacian_sum_apply_of_ne (s : Finset (n × n)) (hs : s ⊆ offDiagLt)
    (ℓ : n → n → ℝ) {i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hmiss : ∀ p ∈ s, ({p.1, p.2} : Set n) ≠ {i, j}) :
    (∑ p ∈ s, ℓ p.1 p.2 • vecMulVec (e p.1 - e p.2) (e p.1 - e p.2)) i j = 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.weighted_sum_diag
statement:
lemma weighted_sum_diag {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [LinearOrder n]
    (ℓ : n → n → ℝ) (i : n) :
    ∑ p, ∑ q, (if p < q then ℓ p q else 0) *
        vecMulVec (e p - e q) (e p - e q) i i =
      ∑ q, (if i < q then ℓ i q else 0) +
        ∑ p, (if p < i then ℓ p i else 0)

name: BollobasNikiforov.weighted_sum_offDiag
statement:
lemma weighted_sum_offDiag {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [LinearOrder n]
    (ℓ : n → n → ℝ) {i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    ∑ p, ∑ q, (if p < q then ℓ p q else 0) *
        vecMulVec (e p - e q) (e p - e q) i j =
      if i < j then -ℓ i j else if j < i then -ℓ j i else 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.woodbury_add_mul_transpose
statement:
lemma woodbury_add_mul_transpose (L : Matrix ι ι R) (F : Matrix ι κ R)
    (hL : IsUnit L) (hW : IsUnit (1 + Fᵀ * L⁻¹ * F)) :
    (L + F * Fᵀ)⁻¹ = L⁻¹ - L⁻¹ * F * (1 + Fᵀ * L⁻¹ * F)⁻¹ * Fᵀ * L⁻¹

name: BollobasNikiforov.yVec_dot_yVec
statement:
lemma yVec_dot_yVec (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ) (j ℓ : Fin p) :
    yVec ρ x j ⬝ᵥ yVec ρ x ℓ =
      Real.sqrt (ρ j) * Real.sqrt (ρ ℓ) * (x j * x ℓ + 1)

name: BollobasNikiforov.MX_extend_submatrix
statement:
lemma MX_extend_submatrix (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (xstar : ℝ) :
    (M (Xconfig s t (configExtendρ ρ ε) (configExtendx x xstar))).submatrix
        configIdxEmbed configIdxEmbed =
      M (Xconfig s t ρ x) +
        diagonal fun α =>
          if configVec s t ρ x α 0 * xstar + configVec s t ρ x α 1 < 0 then
            ε * (configVec s t ρ x α 0 * xstar + configVec s t ρ x α 1) ^ 2
          else 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.MX_extend_submatrix_diag
statement:
lemma MX_extend_submatrix_diag (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (xstar : ℝ) (α : ConfigIdx k p) :
    M (Xconfig s t (configExtendρ ρ ε) (configExtendx x xstar))
        (configIdxEmbed α) (configIdxEmbed α) =
      M (Xconfig s t ρ x) α α +
        if configVec s t ρ x α 0 * xstar + configVec s t ρ x α 1 < 0 then
          ε * (configVec s t ρ x α 0 * xstar + configVec s t ρ x α 1) ^ 2
        else 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.MX_extend_submatrix_diag_add
statement:
lemma MX_extend_submatrix_diag_add (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)
    (ε xstar : ℝ) (α : ConfigIdx k p) :
    M (Xconfig s t (configExtendρ ρ ε) (configExtendx x xstar))
        (configIdxEmbed α) (configIdxEmbed α) =
      M (Xconfig s t ρ x) α α +
        if Xconfig s t (configExtendρ ρ ε) (configExtendx x xstar)
            (configIdxEmbed α) (idxY (Fin.last p)) < 0 then
          Xconfig s t (configExtendρ ρ ε) (configExtendx x xstar)
            (configIdxEmbed α) (idxY (Fin.last p)) ^ 2
        else 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.MX_extend_submatrix_of_ne

lemma MX_extend_submatrix_of_ne (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)

    M (Xconfig s t (configExtendρ ρ ε) (configExtendx x xstar))

      M (Xconfig s t ρ x) α β

name: BollobasNikiforov.Xconfig_embed_ystar
statement:
lemma Xconfig_embed_ystar (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ) (ε xstar : ℝ)
    (α : ConfigIdx k p) :
    Xconfig s t (configExtendρ ρ ε) (configExtendx x xstar)
        (configIdxEmbed α) (idxY (Fin.last p)) =
      Real.sqrt ε *
        (configVec s t ρ x α 0 * xstar + configVec s t ρ x α 1)

lemma det2_perturbTied {z : n → Fin 2 → ℝ} {i0 : n} {v : Fin 2 → ℝ}

name: BollobasNikiforov.exists_config_of_rotated_unique
statement:
lemma exists_config_of_rotated_unique (z : n → Fin 2 → ℝ) (i0 : n)
    (hz0 : z i0 = z0) (hup : ∀ i, i ≠ i0 → 0 < z i 1)
    (hleft : ∃ i, z i 0 < 0) :
    ∃ (k p : ℕ) (_ : 0 < k) (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)
      (e : n ≃ ConfigIdx k p),
      (∀ i, 0 < s i) ∧ (∀ i, 0 < t i) ∧ (∀ j, 0 < ρ j) ∧ (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧
        ∀ i, z i = configVec s t ρ x (e i)

name: BollobasNikiforov.exists_config_of_unique_minimizer
statement:
lemma exists_config_of_unique_minimizer (z : n → Fin 2 → ℝ)
    (hnz : ∀ i, z i ≠ 0)
    (hopen : ∃ w : Fin 2 → ℝ, w ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ i, 0 < w ⬝ᵥ z i)
    (hneg : ∃ i j, z i ⬝ᵥ z j < 0) (i0 : n)
    (hside : ∀ i, 0 ≤ det2 (normalize (z i0)) (z i))
    (huniq : ∀ i, det2 (normalize (z i0)) (z i) = 0 → i = i0) :
    ∃ (k p : ℕ) (_ : 0 < k) (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)
      (e : n ≃ ConfigIdx k p) (c : ℝ),
      0 < c ∧ (∀ i, 0 < s i) ∧ (∀ i, 0 < t i) ∧ (∀ j, 0 < ρ j) ∧ (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧
        ∀ i, c • rotateTo (normalize (z i0)) (z i) = configVec s t ρ x (e i)

name: BollobasNikiforov.normalize_inner
statement:
lemma normalize_inner {w : Fin 2 → ℝ} (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    normalize w ⬝ᵥ normalize w = 1

name: BollobasNikiforov.normalize_rotateTo
statement:
lemma normalize_rotateTo (u x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (hu : u ⬝ᵥ u = 1) (_hx : x ≠ 0) :
    normalize (rotateTo u x) = rotateTo u (normalize x)

name: BollobasNikiforov.not_mem_configLeft_of_z0
statement:
lemma not_mem_configLeft_of_z0 {z : n → Fin 2 → ℝ} {i0 : n}
    (hz0 : z i0 = z0) : i0 ∉ configLeft z

name: BollobasNikiforov.permIdx_y
statement:
lemma permIdx_y {k p : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) (j : Fin p) :
    permIdx (k := k) σ (idxY j) = idxY j

name: BollobasNikiforov.permIdx_z
statement:
lemma permIdx_z {k p : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) (i : Fin k) :
    permIdx (p := p) σ (idxZ i) = idxZ (σ i)

name: BollobasNikiforov.permIdx_z0
statement:
lemma permIdx_z0 {k p : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) :
    permIdx (p := p) σ idxZ0 = idxZ0

name: BollobasNikiforov.perturbTied_i0
statement:
lemma perturbTied_i0 (z : n → Fin 2 → ℝ) (i0 : n) (v : Fin 2 → ℝ) (ε : ℝ) :
    perturbTied z i0 v ε i0 = z i0

name: BollobasNikiforov.perturbTied_ne_zero
statement:
lemma perturbTied_ne_zero [Nonempty n] {z : n → Fin 2 → ℝ} {i0 : n}
    {v : Fin 2 → ℝ} (hnz : ∀ i, z i ≠ 0) (hv : euclid v = 1)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 < ε)
    (hε : ε < Finset.univ.inf' Finset.univ_nonempty fun i => euclid (z i))
    (i : n) : perturbTied z i0 v ε i ≠ 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.perturbTied_of_ne
statement:
lemma perturbTied_of_ne (z : n → Fin 2 → ℝ) {i0 i : n} (hi : i ≠ i0)
    (v : Fin 2 → ℝ) (ε : ℝ) :
    perturbTied z i0 v ε i = z i + ε • v

name: BollobasNikiforov.perturbTied_zero
statement:
lemma perturbTied_zero (z : n → Fin 2 → ℝ) (i0 : n) (v : Fin 2 → ℝ) :
    perturbTied z i0 v 0 = z

name: BollobasNikiforov.rotate90_inner
statement: lemma rotate90_inner (u : Fin 2 → ℝ) : rotate90 u ⬝ᵥ rotate90 u = u ⬝ᵥ u

name: BollobasNikiforov.rotate90_one
statement: lemma rotate90_one (u : Fin 2 → ℝ) : rotate90 u 1 = u 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.rotate90_zero
statement: lemma rotate90_zero (u : Fin 2 → ℝ) : rotate90 u 0 = -u 1

name: BollobasNikiforov.rotateTo_apply_zero_vec
statement: lemma rotateTo_apply_zero_vec (u : Fin 2 → ℝ) : rotateTo u 0 = 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.rotateTo_eq_z0
statement:
lemma rotateTo_eq_z0 (u : Fin 2 → ℝ) (hu : u ⬝ᵥ u = 1) :
    rotateTo u u = z0

name: BollobasNikiforov.rotateTo_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma rotateTo_eq_zero_iff (u x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (hu : u ⬝ᵥ u = 1) :
    rotateTo u x = 0 ↔ x = 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.rotateTo_inner
statement:
lemma rotateTo_inner (u x y : Fin 2 → ℝ) (hu : u ⬝ᵥ u = 1) :
    rotateTo u x ⬝ᵥ rotateTo u y = x ⬝ᵥ y

name: BollobasNikiforov.rotateTo_normalize_self
statement:
lemma rotateTo_normalize_self {v : Fin 2 → ℝ} (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    rotateTo (normalize v) v = euclid v • z0

name: BollobasNikiforov.rotateTo_one
statement: lemma rotateTo_one (u x : Fin 2 → ℝ) : rotateTo u x 1 = det2 u x

name: BollobasNikiforov.rotateTo_smul
statement:
lemma rotateTo_smul (u : Fin 2 → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) :
    rotateTo u (c • x) = c • rotateTo u x

name: BollobasNikiforov.rotateTo_zero
statement: lemma rotateTo_zero (u x : Fin 2 → ℝ) : rotateTo u x 0 = u ⬝ᵥ x

name: BollobasNikiforov.shiftBy_ne_zero
statement:
lemma shiftBy_ne_zero (z : n → Fin 2 → ℝ) {w : Fin 2 → ℝ} (hw : w ≠ 0)
    (hwz : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w ⬝ᵥ z i) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (i : n) :
    z i + ε • w ≠ 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.smul_normalize
statement:
lemma smul_normalize {w : Fin 2 → ℝ} (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    euclid w • normalize w = w

name: BollobasNikiforov.smul_rotateTo_normalize_self
statement:
lemma smul_rotateTo_normalize_self {v : Fin 2 → ℝ} (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    (euclid v)⁻¹ • rotateTo (normalize v) v = z0

name: BollobasNikiforov.sum_comp_injective
statement:
lemma sum_comp_injective {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (σ : ι → n) (hσ : Function.Injective σ) (f : n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ j, j ∉ Set.range σ → f j = 0) :
    ∑ j : n, f j = ∑ a : ι, f (σ a)

name: BollobasNikiforov.vecMulVec_edge_diag
statement:
lemma vecMulVec_edge_diag (p q i : n) :
    vecMulVec (e p - e q) (e p - e q) i i =
      if p ≠ q ∧ (p = i ∨ q = i) then (1 : ℝ) else 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.add_smul_e_sub_e_apply
statement:
lemma add_smul_e_sub_e_apply {i j : V} (hne : i ≠ j) (y : V → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (k : V) :
    (y + t • (e i - e j)) k =
      if k = i then y i + t else if k = j then y j - t else y k

name: BollobasNikiforov.add_smul_e_sub_e_mem_stdSimplex
statement:
lemma add_smul_e_sub_e_mem_stdSimplex {i j : V} (hne : i ≠ j)
    {y : V → ℝ} (hy : y ∈ stdSimplex ℝ V) {t : ℝ}
    (hti : 0 ≤ y i + t) (htj : 0 ≤ y j - t) :
    y + t • (e i - e j) ∈ stdSimplex ℝ V

name: BollobasNikiforov.adjMatrix_dotProduct_e_sub_e
statement:
lemma adjMatrix_dotProduct_e_sub_e (y : V → ℝ) {i j : V} :
    (e i - e j) ⬝ᵥ G.adjMatrix ℝ *ᵥ y =
      (G.adjMatrix ℝ *ᵥ y) i - (G.adjMatrix ℝ *ᵥ y) j

name: BollobasNikiforov.adjMatrix_quadratic_add_smul_single_sub_single
statement:
lemma adjMatrix_quadratic_add_smul_single_sub_single
    {i j : V} (hij : ¬ G.Adj i j) (hne : i ≠ j) (y : V → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (hti : 0 ≤ y i + t) (htj : 0 ≤ y j - t) :
    (y + t • (e i - e j)) ⬝ᵥ G.adjMatrix ℝ *ᵥ (y + t • (e i - e j)) =
      y ⬝ᵥ G.adjMatrix ℝ *ᵥ y +
        2 * t * ((G.adjMatrix ℝ *ᵥ y) i - (G.adjMatrix ℝ *ᵥ y) j)

name: BollobasNikiforov.adjMatrix_quadratic_e_sub_e
statement:
lemma adjMatrix_quadratic_e_sub_e {i j : V} (hij : ¬ G.Adj i j) (_hne : i ≠ j) :
    (e i - e j) ⬝ᵥ G.adjMatrix ℝ *ᵥ (e i - e j) = 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.adjMatrix_quadratic_eq_sum_sq_sub_of_isClique
statement:
lemma adjMatrix_quadratic_eq_sum_sq_sub_of_isClique
    {s : Set V} (hs : G.IsClique s) {y : V → ℝ}
    (hsupp : ∀ v, y v ≠ 0 → v ∈ s) :
    y ⬝ᵥ G.adjMatrix ℝ *ᵥ y = (∑ i, y i) ^ 2 - ∑ i, y i ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.adjMatrix_quadratic_le_turanFactor_of_isClique_support
statement:
lemma adjMatrix_quadratic_le_turanFactor_of_isClique_support
    {y : V → ℝ} (hy : y ∈ stdSimplex ℝ V)
    (hc : G.IsClique {v | y v ≠ 0}) :
    y ⬝ᵥ G.adjMatrix ℝ *ᵥ y ≤ turanFactor G

name: BollobasNikiforov.adjMatrix_quadratic_le_turanFactor_of_mem_stdSimplex
statement:
lemma adjMatrix_quadratic_le_turanFactor_of_mem_stdSimplex
    [Nonempty V] {y : V → ℝ} (hy : y ∈ stdSimplex ℝ V) :
    y ⬝ᵥ G.adjMatrix ℝ *ᵥ y ≤ turanFactor G

name: BollobasNikiforov.adjMatrix_quadratic_smul
statement:
lemma adjMatrix_quadratic_smul (c : ℝ) (y : V → ℝ) :
    (c • y) ⬝ᵥ G.adjMatrix ℝ *ᵥ (c • y) =
      c ^ 2 * (y ⬝ᵥ G.adjMatrix ℝ *ᵥ y)

name: BollobasNikiforov.adjMatrix_quadratic_symm
statement:
lemma adjMatrix_quadratic_symm (y d : V → ℝ) :
    y ⬝ᵥ G.adjMatrix ℝ *ᵥ d = d ⬝ᵥ G.adjMatrix ℝ *ᵥ y

name: BollobasNikiforov.continuous_adjMatrix_quadratic
statement:
lemma continuous_adjMatrix_quadratic :
    Continuous fun y : V → ℝ => y ⬝ᵥ G.adjMatrix ℝ *ᵥ y

name: BollobasNikiforov.exists_isMaxOn_adjMatrix_quadratic
statement:
lemma exists_isMaxOn_adjMatrix_quadratic [Nonempty V] :
    ∃ y, y ∈ stdSimplex ℝ V ∧
      IsMaxOn (fun y : V → ℝ => y ⬝ᵥ G.adjMatrix ℝ *ᵥ y) (stdSimplex ℝ V) y

name: BollobasNikiforov.exists_isMaxOn_adjMatrix_quadratic_isClique_support
statement:
lemma exists_isMaxOn_adjMatrix_quadratic_isClique_support [Nonempty V] :
    ∃ y, y ∈ stdSimplex ℝ V ∧
      IsMaxOn (fun y : V → ℝ => y ⬝ᵥ G.adjMatrix ℝ *ᵥ y) (stdSimplex ℝ V) y ∧
      G.IsClique {v | y v ≠ 0}

name: BollobasNikiforov.inner_adjMatrix_le_turanFactor_inner
statement:
lemma inner_adjMatrix_le_turanFactor_inner {C : Matrix V V ℝ}
    (hC : IsCompletelyPositive C) :
    inner (G.adjMatrix ℝ) C ≤
      turanFactor G * inner (of fun _ _ => (1 : ℝ)) C

name: BollobasNikiforov.inner_one_vecMulVec
statement:
lemma inner_one_vecMulVec (p : V → ℝ) :
    inner (of fun _ _ => (1 : ℝ)) (vecMulVec p p) = (∑ i, p i) ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.inner_sum
statement:
lemma inner_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (B : Matrix V V ℝ)
    (C : ι → Matrix V V ℝ) :
    inner B (∑ a ∈ s, C a) = ∑ a ∈ s, inner B (C a)

name: BollobasNikiforov.inner_vecMulVec
statement:
lemma inner_vecMulVec (B : Matrix V V ℝ) (p : V → ℝ) :
    inner B (vecMulVec p p) = p ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ p

name: BollobasNikiforov.isClosed_stdSimplex
statement: lemma isClosed_stdSimplex (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] : IsClosed (stdSimplex ℝ ι)

name: BollobasNikiforov.isCompact_stdSimplex
statement: lemma isCompact_stdSimplex (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] : IsCompact (stdSimplex ℝ ι)

name: BollobasNikiforov.motzkinStraus
statement:
lemma motzkinStraus {y : V → ℝ} (hy : ∀ i, 0 ≤ y i) :
    y ⬝ᵥ G.adjMatrix ℝ *ᵥ y ≤ turanFactor G * (∑ i, y i) ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.mulVec_adjMatrix_dotProduct
statement:
lemma mulVec_adjMatrix_dotProduct (y : V → ℝ) :
    mulVec (G.adjMatrix ℝ) y ⬝ᵥ y =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, (if G.Adj i j then y i * y j else 0)

name: BollobasNikiforov.single_mem_stdSimplex
statement:
lemma single_mem_stdSimplex {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (i : ι) :
    Pi.single i (1 : ℝ) ∈ stdSimplex ℝ ι

name: BollobasNikiforov.stdSimplex_nonempty
statement: lemma stdSimplex_nonempty [Nonempty V] : (stdSimplex ℝ V).Nonempty

name: BollobasNikiforov.stdSimplex_subset_Icc
statement:
lemma stdSimplex_subset_Icc (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] :
    stdSimplex ℝ ι ⊆ Set.Icc 0 1

name: BollobasNikiforov.sum_e_sub_e
statement:
lemma sum_e_sub_e {i j : V} :
    ∑ k, (e i - e j) k = 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.sum_sq_le_card_mul_sum_sq
statement:
lemma sum_sq_le_card_mul_sum_sq {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (y : ι → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, y i) ^ 2 ≤ Fintype.card ι * ∑ i, y i ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.sum_sq_le_card_mul_sum_sq_finset
statement:
lemma sum_sq_le_card_mul_sum_sq_finset {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (y : ι → ℝ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, y i) ^ 2 ≤ s.card * ∑ i ∈ s, y i ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.sum_sq_sub_sum_sq_le
statement:
lemma sum_sq_sub_sum_sq_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (y : ι → ℝ)
    (hk : 1 ≤ Fintype.card ι) :
    (∑ i, y i) ^ 2 - ∑ i, y i ^ 2 ≤
      (1 - 1 / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)) * (∑ i, y i) ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.sum_sq_sub_sum_sq_le_finset
statement:
lemma sum_sq_sub_sum_sq_le_finset {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (y : ι → ℝ)
    (hk : 1 ≤ s.card) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, y i) ^ 2 - ∑ i ∈ s, y i ^ 2 ≤
      (1 - 1 / (s.card : ℝ)) * (∑ i ∈ s, y i) ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.continuous_dotProduct_mulVec
statement:
lemma continuous_dotProduct_mulVec :
    Continuous fun x : n → ℝ => x ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ x

name: BollobasNikiforov.dotProduct_mulVec_le_abs
statement:
lemma dotProduct_mulVec_le_abs (hnn : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ B i j) (x : n → ℝ) :
    x ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ x ≤ |x| ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ |x|

name: BollobasNikiforov.exists_isMaxOn_dotProduct_mulVec
statement:
lemma exists_isMaxOn_dotProduct_mulVec (_hB : B.IsHermitian) [Nonempty n] :
    ∃ u, u ∈ l2Sphere ∧ IsMaxOn (fun x : n → ℝ => x ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ x) l2Sphere u

name: BollobasNikiforov.exists_nonneg_eigenvector_lambdaMax
statement:
lemma exists_nonneg_eigenvector_lambdaMax (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (hnn : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ B i j) [Nonempty n] :
    ∃ u : n → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ u i) ∧ ∑ i, u i ^ 2 = 1 ∧ B *ᵥ u = lambdaMax hB • u

name: BollobasNikiforov.exists_nonneg_isMaxOn_dotProduct_mulVec
statement:
lemma exists_nonneg_isMaxOn_dotProduct_mulVec (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (hnn : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ B i j) [Nonempty n] :
    ∃ u, u ∈ l2Sphere ∧ (∀ i, 0 ≤ u i) ∧
      IsMaxOn (fun x : n → ℝ => x ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ x) l2Sphere u

name: BollobasNikiforov.isCompact_l2Sphere
statement: lemma isCompact_l2Sphere : IsCompact (l2Sphere : Set (n → ℝ))

name: BollobasNikiforov.l2Sphere_nonempty
statement: lemma l2Sphere_nonempty [Nonempty n] : (l2Sphere : Set (n → ℝ)).Nonempty

name: BollobasNikiforov.mem_l2Sphere
statement: lemma mem_l2Sphere {x : n → ℝ} : x ∈ l2Sphere ↔ ∑ i, x i ^ 2 = 1

name: BollobasNikiforov.SpectralSlice.a_nonneg
statement: lemma a_nonneg : 0 ≤ s.a

name: BollobasNikiforov.SpectralSlice.b_nonneg
statement: lemma b_nonneg : 0 ≤ s.b

name: BollobasNikiforov.SpectralSlice.col_eq
statement:
lemma col_eq (j : n) :
    s.X.col j = (s.a * s.u j) • s.u + (s.b * s.v j) • s.v

name: BollobasNikiforov.SpectralSlice.embed_nonneg_fst
statement: lemma embed_nonneg_fst (i : n) : 0 ≤ s.embed i 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.SpectralSlice.gram
statement: lemma gram (i j : n) : s.X i j = s.embed i ⬝ᵥ s.embed j

name: BollobasNikiforov.SpectralSlice.hv_dot
statement: lemma hv_dot : s.v ⬝ᵥ s.v = if 0 < s.b then 1 else 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.SpectralSlice.inner_B_X
statement: lemma inner_B_X : inner B s.X = F hB

name: BollobasNikiforov.SpectralSlice.inner_B_X_eq_inner_X_X
statement: lemma inner_B_X_eq_inner_X_X : inner B s.X = inner s.X s.X

name: BollobasNikiforov.SpectralSlice.inner_B_X_eq_sq
statement: lemma inner_B_X_eq_sq : inner B s.X = s.a ^ 2 + s.b ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.SpectralSlice.inner_X_X
statement: lemma inner_X_X : inner s.X s.X = F hB

name: BollobasNikiforov.SpectralSlice.inner_X_X_eq_sq
statement: lemma inner_X_X_eq_sq : inner s.X s.X = s.a ^ 2 + s.b ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.SpectralSlice.inner_pos
statement: lemma inner_pos (hB0 : B ≠ 0) : 0 < inner s.X s.X

name: BollobasNikiforov.SpectralSlice.lambdaMax_pos_of_ne_zero
statement: lemma lambdaMax_pos_of_ne_zero (hB0 : B ≠ 0) : 0 < s.a

name: BollobasNikiforov.SpectralSlice.posSemidef
statement: lemma posSemidef : s.X.PosSemidef

name: BollobasNikiforov.SpectralSlice.rank_le_two
statement: lemma rank_le_two : s.X.rank ≤ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.eigenvalues_lambdaMaxIndex
statement:
lemma eigenvalues_lambdaMaxIndex (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    hB.eigenvalues lambdaMaxIndex = lambdaMax hB

name: BollobasNikiforov.eigenvalues_lambdaSecondIndex
statement:
lemma eigenvalues_lambdaSecondIndex (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    hB.eigenvalues lambdaSecondIndex = lambdaSecond hB

name: BollobasNikiforov.eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct
statement:
lemma eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct (hB : B.IsHermitian) {i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (hB.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ (hB.eigenvectorBasis j : n → ℝ) = 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.eigenvectorBasis_sum_sq
statement:
lemma eigenvectorBasis_sum_sq (hB : B.IsHermitian) (i : n) :
    ∑ k, (hB.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) k ^ 2 = 1

name: BollobasNikiforov.exists_second_eigenvec
statement:
lemma exists_second_eigenvec (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    {u : n → ℝ} (hu : B *ᵥ u = lambdaMax hB • u) (hu1 : ∑ i, u i ^ 2 = 1)
    (_hb : 0 < lambdaSecond hB) :
    ∃ v : n → ℝ, ∑ i, v i ^ 2 = 1 ∧ u ⬝ᵥ v = 0 ∧
      B *ᵥ v = lambdaSecond hB • v

name: BollobasNikiforov.inner_hadamard_posPart_le_sqrt
statement:
lemma inner_hadamard_posPart_le_sqrt (X : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    inner B (G.adjMatrix ℝ ⊙ posPart X) ≤
      Real.sqrt (inner B B) *
        Real.sqrt (∑ i, ∑ j, G.adjMatrix ℝ i j * (posPart X i j) ^ 2)

name: BollobasNikiforov.inner_le_inner_hadamard_posPart
statement:
lemma inner_le_inner_hadamard_posPart {X : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hnn : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ B i j) (hdiag : ∀ i, B i i = 0)
    (hsupp : ∀ i j, ¬ G.Adj i j → B i j = 0) :
    inner B X ≤ inner B (G.adjMatrix ℝ ⊙ posPart X)

name: BollobasNikiforov.inner_smul_vecMulVec
statement:
lemma inner_smul_vecMulVec (r : ℝ) (C : Matrix n n ℝ) (u : n → ℝ) :
    inner C (r • vecMulVec u u) = r * (u ⬝ᵥ C *ᵥ u)

name: BollobasNikiforov.inner_vecMulVec_vecMulVec
statement:
lemma inner_vecMulVec_vecMulVec (u v : n → ℝ) :
    inner (vecMulVec u u) (vecMulVec v v) = (u ⬝ᵥ v) ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.isHermitian_dotProduct_mulVec
statement:
lemma isHermitian_dotProduct_mulVec (hB : B.IsHermitian) (x y : n → ℝ) :
    x ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ y = (B *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ y

name: BollobasNikiforov.lambdaMaxIndex_ne_lambdaSecondIndex
statement: lemma lambdaMaxIndex_ne_lambdaSecondIndex : lambdaMaxIndex (n := n) ≠ lambdaSecondIndex

name: BollobasNikiforov.sum_sq_eq_dotProduct
statement: lemma sum_sq_eq_dotProduct (x : n → ℝ) : ∑ i, x i ^ 2 = x ⬝ᵥ x

name: BollobasNikiforov.vecMulVec_mulVec
statement:
lemma vecMulVec_mulVec (u v x : n → ℝ) :
    vecMulVec u v *ᵥ x = (v ⬝ᵥ x) • u

name: BollobasNikiforov.GramAux.bessel_two
BollobasNikiforov.GramAux.cauchySchwarz_two
statement:
lemma cauchySchwarz_two (α β a b : ℝ) :
    α * a + β * b ≤
      Real.sqrt (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)

name: BollobasNikiforov.GramAux.eigenvalues_le_lambdaMax
statement:
lemma eigenvalues_le_lambdaMax [Nonempty n] (hB : B.IsHermitian) (i : n) :
    hB.eigenvalues i ≤ lambdaMax hB

name: BollobasNikiforov.GramAux.eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct
statement:
lemma eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct (hB : B.IsHermitian) {i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (hB.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ (hB.eigenvectorBasis j : n → ℝ) = 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.GramAux.eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_self
statement:
lemma eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_self (hB : B.IsHermitian) (i : n) :
    (hB.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ (hB.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) = 1

name: BollobasNikiforov.GramAux.exists_card_one_writing
statement:
lemma exists_card_one_writing (hn : Fintype.card n = 1) {X : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hX : X.PosSemidef) :
    ∃ (u : n → ℝ) (α : ℝ),
      0 ≤ α ∧ u ⬝ᵥ u = 1 ∧ X = α • vecMulVec u u

name: BollobasNikiforov.GramAux.exists_rankTwo_writing
statement:
lemma exists_rankTwo_writing [Nontrivial n] {X : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hX : X.PosSemidef) (hr : X.rank ≤ 2) :
    ∃ (u v : n → ℝ) (α β : ℝ),
      0 ≤ β ∧ β ≤ α ∧ u ⬝ᵥ u = 1 ∧ v ⬝ᵥ v = 1 ∧ u ⬝ᵥ v = 0 ∧
        X = α • vecMulVec u u + β • vecMulVec v v

name: BollobasNikiforov.GramAux.inner_rankTwo
statement:
lemma inner_rankTwo (C : Matrix n n ℝ) (u v : n → ℝ) (α β : ℝ) :
    inner C (α • vecMulVec u u + β • vecMulVec v v) =
      α * (u ⬝ᵥ C *ᵥ u) + β * (v ⬝ᵥ C *ᵥ v)

name: BollobasNikiforov.GramAux.inner_self_rankTwo
statement:
lemma inner_self_rankTwo {u v : n → ℝ} (hu : u ⬝ᵥ u = 1) (hv : v ⬝ᵥ v = 1)
    (huv : u ⬝ᵥ v = 0) (α β : ℝ) :
    inner (α • vecMulVec u u + β • vecMulVec v v)
        (α • vecMulVec u u + β • vecMulVec v v) =
      α ^ 2 + β ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.GramAux.inner_smul_vecMulVec'
statement:
lemma inner_smul_vecMulVec' (r : ℝ) (C : Matrix n n ℝ) (u : n → ℝ) :
    inner C (r • vecMulVec u u) = r * (u ⬝ᵥ C *ᵥ u)

name: BollobasNikiforov.GramAux.inner_vecMulVec'
statement:
lemma inner_vecMulVec' (C : Matrix n n ℝ) (u : n → ℝ) :
    inner C (vecMulVec u u) = u ⬝ᵥ C *ᵥ u

name: BollobasNikiforov.GramAux.inner_vecMulVec_vecMulVec'
statement:
lemma inner_vecMulVec_vecMulVec' (u v : n → ℝ) :

name: BollobasNikiforov.GramAux.isHermitian_quadratic
statement:
lemma isHermitian_quadratic (hB : B.IsHermitian) (x : n → ℝ) :
    x ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ x =
      ∑ k, hB.eigenvalues k *
        ((hB.eigenvectorBasis k : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.GramAux.orthonormal_pair_le_lambdaMax_add_lambdaSecond
statement:
lemma orthonormal_pair_le_lambdaMax_add_lambdaSecond [Nontrivial n]
    (hB : B.IsHermitian) {u v : n → ℝ}
    (hu : u ⬝ᵥ u = 1) (hv : v ⬝ᵥ v = 1) (huv : u ⬝ᵥ v = 0) :
    u ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ u + v ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ v ≤ lambdaMax hB + lambdaSecond hB

name: BollobasNikiforov.GramAux.parseval_eigenvectorBasis
statement:
lemma parseval_eigenvectorBasis (hB : B.IsHermitian) (x : n → ℝ) :

lemma int_sum_mul_le_of_prefix_le_of_antitone_weight
    (M : ℕ) (u v w : ℕ → ℤ)
    (hpref : ∀ r ≤ M, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range r, v i ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range r, u i)
    (htot : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range M, u i = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range M, v i)
    (_ : ∀ i, i < M → 0 ≤ w i)
    (hwanti : ∀ i, i + 1 < M → w (i + 1) ≤ w i) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range M, w i * v i ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range M, w i * u i

      H (n + 1) (a + i) + H (n + 1) (b - i)) :
    H (n + 1) c + H (n + 1) d ≤ H (n + 1) a + H (n + 1) b

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.harper_extremal_step_nested_q_zero
statement:
lemma harper_extremal_step_nested_q_zero (n : ℕ)
    (_ih : ∀ m, m < n + 1 → ∀ x y, x ≤ 2 ^ m → y ≤ 2 ^ m →
            H (m + 1) (x + y) ≤ max (H m x) y + max (H m y) x)
    {a b p q p0 p1 q0 q1 a0 a1 b0 b1 : ℕ}
    (ha : a ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1)) (hb : b ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1))
    (hcasc : CascadeSplit (n + 1) (a + b) p q)
    (hq_zero : q = 0)
    (_hp0 : p0 ≤ 2 ^ n) (_hp1 : p1 ≤ 2 ^ n)
    (_hq0 : q0 ≤ 2 ^ n) (_hq1 : q1 ≤ 2 ^ n)
    (_ha0 : a0 ≤ 2 ^ n) (_ha1 : a1 ≤ 2 ^ n)
    (_hb0 : b0 ≤ 2 ^ n) (_hb1 : b1 ≤ 2 ^ n)
    (hp_split : CascadeSplit n p p0 p1)
    (hq_split : CascadeSplit n q q0 q1)
    (ha_split : CascadeSplit n a a0 a1)
    (hb_split : CascadeSplit n b b0 b1) :
    max (max (H n p0) p1 + max (H n p1) p0) q +
    max (max (H n q0) q1 + max (H n q1) q0) p ≤
    max (max (H n a0) a1 + max (H n a1) a0) b +
    max (max (H n b0) b1 + max (H n b1) b0) a

lemma minDelta_pair_admissible {N : ℕ} {A : Finset (Cube N)} {T S : Cube N}

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.CoherentGap.iteratedLift_basis_eq
statement:
lemma iteratedLift_basis_eq {n : ℕ} (coordinate : Fin n) :
    ∀ {steps : ℕ} (hsteps : 0 < steps),
      iteratedLift (basis coordinate) steps =
        basis (⟨coordinate.val + steps, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + steps)) -
          basis (⟨steps - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + steps))
  | 0, hsteps => by omega
  | 1, _ => by
      change lift (basis coordinate) =
        basis (⟨coordinate.val + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + 1)) -
          basis (⟨1 - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + 1))
      rw [lift_basis]
      have hpositive :
          coordinate.succ =
            (⟨coordinate.val + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + 1))

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.H_shadow_LE_sum_as_upperShadow
statement:
theorem H_shadow_LE_sum_as_upperShadow {N a b p q ra rb rp rq ta tb tp tq : ℕ}
    (hra : 1 ≤ ra) (hrb : 1 ≤ rb) (hrp : 1 ≤ rp) (hrq : 1 ≤ rq)
    (hae : a = binomPrefix N ra + ta) (hbe : b = binomPrefix N rb + tb)
    (hpe : p = binomPrefix N rp + tp) (hqe : q = binomPrefix N rq + tq) :
    (H N p + H N q ≤ H N a + H N b) ↔
      (binomPrefix N (rp + 1) + upperShadow N rp tp)
        + (binomPrefix N (rq + 1) + upperShadow N rq tq)
      ≤ (binomPrefix N (ra + 1) + upperShadow N ra ta)
        + (binomPrefix N (rb + 1) + upperShadow N rb tb)

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.H_shadow_closed_form

theorem H_shadow_closed_form (N r t : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) :

            H (m + 1) (x + y) ≤ max (H m x) y + max (H m y) x)
    (ha : a ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1)) (hb : b ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1))
    (h_inter : CascadeInterleaves (n + 1) p q a b) :

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.boundaryCost_le_of_lower_interleaves_step_live
statement:
lemma boundaryCost_le_of_lower_interleaves_step_live
    (n p q a b p0 p1 q0 q1 a0 a1 b0 b1 : ℕ)
    (_ : ∀ m, m < n + 1 → ∀ x y, x ≤ 2 ^ m → y ≤ 2 ^ m →
            H (m + 1) (x + y) ≤ max (H m x) y + max (H m y) x)
    (ha_cap : a ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1)) (hb_cap : b ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1))
    (hba : b ≤ a)
    (hpq_casc : CascadeSplit (n + 1) (a + b) p q)
    (hp : CascadeSplit n p p0 p1) (hq : CascadeSplit n q q0 q1)
    (_ : CascadeSplit n a a0 a1) (hb : CascadeSplit n b b0 b1)
    (_ : ∀ l,
      splitPrefixMass n a0 b0 (l + 1) + splitPrefixMass n a1 b1 l
        ≤ splitPrefixMass n p0 q0 (l + 1) + splitPrefixMass n p1 q1 l) :
    max (H (n + 1) p) q + max (H (n + 1) q) p ≤
      max (H (n + 1) a) b + max (H (n + 1) b) a
